package lanes

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"
)

var researchSetID atomic.Uint64

func researchObserveSet(s *Set) {
	if os.Getenv("WS_WAN_DIAGNOSTICS") == "0" {
		return
	}
	id := researchSetID.Add(1)
	go func() {
		output, err := os.Create(fmt.Sprintf("research-scheduler-%s-%d.ndjson", os.Args[1], id))
		if err != nil {
			return
		}
		defer output.Close()
		encoder := json.NewEncoder(output)
		ticker := time.NewTicker(500 * time.Millisecond)
		defer ticker.Stop()
		for {
			select {
			case <-s.lifecycle.Done():
				return
			case <-ticker.C:
			}
			demand := s.SchedulingDemand()
			s.mu.Lock()
			pending := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(s.pending))
			for _, p := range s.pending {
				attempted := make([]Identity, 0, len(p.attempted))
				for identity := range p.attempted {
					attempted = append(attempted, identity)
				}
				pending = append(pending, map[string]any{
					"block": p.request.Demand.Index, "attempted": attempted,
					"blocked": p.blocked, "done": p.done, "ageMs": time.Since(p.queuedAt).Milliseconds(),
				})
			}
			lanes := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(s.lanes))
			for _, lane := range s.lanes {
				lanes = append(lanes, map[string]any{
					"identity": lane.identity, "route": lane.route,
					"allowed":   s.contentRoutePolicy.Allows(lane.route),
					"suspended": s.contentSuspensions[lane.identity.ID] != nil,
					"inflight":  lane.inflight, "pendingBytes": lane.performance.PendingBytes,
					"unfinished": lane.receive.UnfinishedBytes(), "failures": lane.failures,
					"available": lane.receive.Available(), "usefulBytes": lane.usefulBytes,
				})
			}
			s.mu.Unlock()
			_ = encoder.Encode(map[string]any{"timeMs": time.Now().UnixMilli(), "demand": demand, "pending": pending, "lanes": lanes})
		}
	}()
}
